title: Historical secret.key import through the legacy Wallet importer

summary.text: A historical Daedalus workflow used a dedicated Wallet importer screen for secret.key files; the original reporter later confirmed recovery.

problem.text: The reporter retained a legacy secret.key but no recovery phrase and could not import the file into a later Daedalus installation.

symptoms.text: A legacy secret.key is rejected when selected through the Add wallet import dialog.

daedalus.notes: The issue and comments describe a historical importer workflow but do not identify the exact supporting release in these source elements; no version is guessed.

causes.claim: The contributor identifies use of the Add wallet import dialog instead of the dedicated historical Wallet importer screen.

diagnostics.action: For this historical case, distinguish the Add wallet import dialog from the Daedalus > Wallet importer screen.
diagnostics.why: The contributor states that secret.key was not accepted through the Add wallet import dialog.

resolutions.action: In the historical Daedalus build discussed by the source, open Daedalus > Wallet importer and select the secret.key there.
resolutions.why: The contributor directs the reporter to that dedicated screen rather than the Add wallet import dialog.

expected_outcome.text: The original reporter first states that restoration is in progress and later confirms that the wallet was recovered.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, or spending passwords.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Work only on a copy; preserve the original file offline.
consequences: Mishandling the only legacy backup may prevent recovery.
recovery: Return to the untouched original copy if an attempted import changes the working copy.

evidence.rationale: A repository contributor supplies the historical navigation instruction and the original reporter separately confirms progress and recovery; exact current-version applicability is unknown.

lifecycle.reason: Legacy wallet format and workflow; retained for older installations.
